ns2:course.label: Reading for Writers
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes the craft of short stories and poems through the study of formal elements central to the production of creative writing (e.g., plot, character, setting, point of view in short fiction and rhythm, meter, line break, imagery, simile, metaphor, formal patterns in poetry). Prerequisite: CW 104 or CW 106. For majors only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CW 104 or CW 106. For majors only.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Creative Writing or Creative Writing major(s) or minor(s).
